cloudColor: Star/Sector Map Nebula Clouds. Influenced by the background color of Space.
noiseColor: The Static/Grain effect overlay on UI Screens and other elements.
fogOfWarColor: Tint of the tactical maps Fog of War effect when in combat.
buttonBg: The primary background color for UI buttons. Influenced by other UI colors.
buttonBgDark: Shadowing for buttons and other UI elements, this provides a recessed 3D effect.
buttonText: Text within the main buttons on the players HUD.
buttonShortcut: Quick-keys inside buttons IE: the highlighted E in Intel.
storyOptionColor: Story Options in Dialogue. Possibly influenced by other Colors.
hColor: Highlight for keywords in text descriptions.
mountGrayColor: Built-in, decorative, or hidden weapon mounts.
mountCompositeColor: DEFINITION NEEDS REVIEW - Background/label color specifically for Composite slot UI elements.
progressBarFuelColor: Fuel capacity fill bar, Burn Level, Fuel Range.
progressBarOverflowColor: Warning fill bar shown when a resource exceeds capacity.
progressBarHullColor: Hull Integrity fill bar in Fleet Menus.
progressBarCRColor: CR fill bar inside your Fleet Menus
progressBarCrewLossColor: DEFINITION NEEDS REVIEW - Fill bar for crew lost and for crew used when claiming a new ship.
progressBarStandardColor: Non-specific fill bars, such as those in the settings menu.
progressBarFleetPointsColor: DEFINITION NEEDS REVIEW - Deployment Points or fleet size limit bars.
progressBarHangarSpaceColor: DEFINITION NEEDS REVIEW - Fighter Bay/Hangar capacity bar.
graphMarinesColor: Color representing Marines in fleet/market graphs.
graphSuppliesColor: Color representing Supplies in fleet/market graphs.
tooltipTitleAndLightHighlightColor: Tooltip headers and subtle text highlights. IE: Header of a Tooltip, top left Date, and 'Game Paused' text.
widgetBorderColorDark: Darker edge of the two-tone UI frame borders.
widgetBorderColorBright: Brighter edge of the two-tone UI frame borders.
standardUIIconColor: The default tint for generic interface icons.
tripadGridColor: The color of the background grid on the TriPad/Menu screens.
tripadLineColor: The color of decorative scanning lines on the TriPad interface.
flatRedTextColor: Text for negative modifiers or errors.
darkRedTextColor: Text for background warnings or less urgent errors.
yellowTextColor: Text for alerts or neutral-positive information.
textFriendColor: Friendly faction names and ship status. Combat UI text and ship Elements.
textNeutralColor: Text for neutral entities and non-aligned factions.
marketFlavorTextColor: Used for descriptive/lore text in market screens.
weaponArcColor: Weapon Arc Reticle. A weapon mounts range of motion.
bottomMenuButtonInsetColor: The inner border/glow of the main HUD navigation buttons.
Common: Tooltip text for 'Common' tech level items.
Low Tech: Tooltip text for 'Low Tech' ships and weapons.
Midline: Tooltip text for 'Midline' ships and weapons.
High Tech: Tooltip text for 'High Tech' ships and weapons.
Threat: Used for 'Threat' level text in sensor/intel logs.
